get_env.desc: Read an injected secret or env var
get_env.code:
# Secrets & env vars are configured in the Secrets & Env panel and injected
# into the notebook at launch. Read them with the helpers (no os.environ/json):

# Discover what's available (keys only — values are never shown). The two lists
# are a clean split: direct env vars vs Secrets-Manager secrets.
list_env()        # your direct env vars
# list_secret()   # just the Secrets-Manager-backed ones

# Read a value by name. A JSON secret comes back as a dict; a plain value as a
# string (no JSONDecodeError on plaintext).
api_key = get_secret('MY_SECRET_NAME')
print('MY_SECRET_NAME →', '✓ loaded' if api_key is not None else '✗ not set')

# Typed config via as_type (int/float/bool/dict/list); default + required too:
# port  = get_env('DB_PORT', 5432, as_type=int)
# creds = get_secret('DB_CREDS')          # dict if JSON
# token = get_env('API_TOKEN', required=True)

get_secret.desc: Read a secret (JSON -> dict, else string)
